daily_report_items: MP Materials quick check completed: Q2 production, sales and customer evidence support the vertical-integration thesis, but liquidity fell to USD 1.453 billion and the USD 56.67 mark is above the USD 42 base and USD 44.75 weighted values. The accepted assessment is Sell / Avoid and allocation-ineligible; exactly one dependent full Q2 review was queued. No paper trade was created.

The current SEC submissions index confirms that the August 6 results Form 8-K and August 7 Form 10-Q are the latest issuer operating filings through this check.
